answer: Make every agent prove its origin before it can trade: a newcomer must carry a fable of origin, a signed, dated chain showing how it was built and by whom, sealed into an onyx fingerprint that cannot be copied or forged. A duplicate shows a borrowed fable or a fingerprint matching another identity and is frozen. The agent must then descend a canyon of verified work, each layer checked by a different veteran, standing released only as layers clear. Sybil farms must forge a fresh origin story, a new fingerprint, and a full canyon descent for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
